design: There is enough money (£90,000) and a known way: search every store by an agreed list of offence codes, delete or mark records, check the work twice, and tell women only if they ask or by a safe route. A careful plan can meet every test.
tests_hint: Citizens would want: a named date for finishing; a named person who answers questions; no letters sent to women unless they choose; every store searched, including paper and court copies; a check by someone outside the records team; a limit that no names are shared outside the force.
angles: Full sweep by the records team, with an outside check
Hire a sealed-room contractor to do the search
Wait for requests and delete case by case
